contiguous_prefix.format: raw byte prefix only; not a complete tar.xz archive

supplemental_chunks.format: three complete raw chunks in listed offset order; first missing chunk is not included

pause_error.scope: h service calls; root also reported a non-file effective_config probe failed
pause_error.retry_policy: Initial concurrency reduced from 8 to 4; three bounded retries then stop; one probe after about 60 seconds also failed. No permission or version changes attempted.

final_probe.note: Parent instructed use this existing failed single probe as final probe; no further wait or retry.

resume_instructions: Read only missing offsets using h.binary_read with the exact expected_version and remote path above; reject version, size, or path changes.
Validate each returned base64 payload, byte length, chunk SHA256, next_offset, and EOF before saving. Existing complete chunks must match exactly, never be overwritten with differing data.
Reassemble all 938 chunks in offset order only after all missing chunks are available; verify expected archive bytes and full SHA256 before naming the final mem6-cas-001.tar.xz.
Run restore_archive.py only on the fully verified archive, with a new absent destination and absent receipt. Partial prefix inspection is not full archive or owner recovery.
